roads.name: Water Canyon Road
words: Curve after curve after curve: 102 in 8.1 miles, about 13 a mile.
Plenty of tight curves among them.
The curves flow straight into one another.
A big elevation change: 6,750 to 10,419 ft, with 3,915 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every road in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 15 mph limit its corners ask for only about 0.10 g, so the limit, not the curves, sets the pace.

roads.name: Olquin Road
words: An easygoing road: 6 curves in 3.5 miles, with room to breathe between them.
Tight and technical: most curves turn on a radius under 130 ft.
From 5,761 to 6,077 ft, with 315 ft of up and down along the way.
roads.ratingNote: A full bar is top marks for that part; the percentages are each part's share of the rating. Curves, length and up and down are ranked against every sweeper in the library. The rest are scored on the road itself: how few side roads join it, whether the curves or the limit set the pace, and how little is built up along it. At the 55 mph limit its corners still ask for about 1.54 g, so the curves, not the limit, set the pace. Most of it has no posted limit on the map, so this assumes 55 mph.

roads.name: Hop Canyon Road
words: Properly twisty: 19 curves in 3.3 miles, about 6 a mile.
About 2 miles in the middle are tamer.
From 6,959 to 7,604 ft, with 647 ft of up and down along the way.
